source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Understanding Causality' under topic 6.9 (PDF 88, printed 84).

blocks.text: Causality batati hai ke koi waqia kyun hota hai. Yeh cause-and-effect (sabab aur asar) ka rishta dikhati hai: ek factor (awamil) doosre par seedha asar dalta hai. Science ki tehqeeq mein waqiat ki asal wajah samajhne ke liye causality zaroori hai. Sirf data se aksar sabab pata nahi chalta, lekin experiments (tajrubaat) se aksar sabab pehchana ja sakta hai. Sabab samajhne se faisle behtar hote hain aur ghalat mafroozon (false assumptions) se bacha jata hai.
